description: A source page that has gone from the site triages to NO_ACTION.
rationale: There is nothing to review on a page that no longer exists. Any other decision would spend a model call and a reviewer's attention on a dead URL.

description: A source with no current-version analysis triages to REINDEX.

india-ev-insight.body_html:
Indian cities are rethinking urban mobility as delivery operators rebuild their last-mile fleets.

Demand has grown faster in the India electric vehicle market than in any comparable segment, and charging access is now the binding constraint.

Our latest coverage of the electric two-wheelers segment carries the full forecast.

Charging infrastructure

Operators say that ev charging availability, not battery cost, decides how routes are planned. Click here for the methodology.

  • Fleet managers cite the electric vehicle market as their main planning input.

rationale: linkable_as_source is false for hubs. Their links are navigation, which is out of scope for this system.

description: A source below the word-count floor triages to NO_ACTION.
rationale: Adding contextual links to a 40-word stub would push it straight past any sensible link density and gives a reader nothing.
